no_connectable_scanner.title: {name} requires a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy
no_connectable_scanner.description:
Home Assistant can see the scale **{name}**, but only through Bluetooth adapters or proxies that cannot connect to it, so it cannot read weigh-ins.

**To fix this, do one of the following:**
- Add a Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can connect, within range of the scale.
- For an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, set `active: true` under `bluetooth_proxy` in its configuration, then install it on the proxy.

This issue clears at the next weigh-in that Home Assistant can read.

Details: {reason}
